headline: TI authors report adaptive Verilog-AMS glitch checkers for earlier silicon-bug detection
fact: A Texas Instruments DVCon India 2024 paper reports a compact Verilog-AMS checker and assertion library for adaptive detection of kickback and frequency glitches across SPICE and behavioral-model verification. The paper describes automated checker insertion and execution-flow optimization. The word intelligent appears in the paper title, but the supported implementation is an adaptive checker flow rather than a demonstrated generative-AI system.

sources.title: Accelerating Silicon Bug Detection and Optimizing Execution Flow through Intelligent Adaptive Glitch Detectors in AMS Verification
sources.summary: The full paper identifies Aadhar Sharma with Texas Instruments and describes the Verilog-AMS checker library, automated insertion, kickback and frequency cases, and SPICE/behavioral-model scope.
